text: 今年以来“奔私”浪潮持续汹涌。中基协公示信息显示，近日鑫元基金原首席量化投资官LeonLuo（洛里昂）参与创办的岭南见树（上海）私募基金管理有限公司（简称“岭南见树私募”）完成管理人登记，洛里昂出任法定代表人、总经理。据记者不完全统计，今年以来，有近30位曾就职于公募、券商等机构的投研人士创立或加入私募机构。在业内人士看来，越来越多人“奔私”背后是相关人士对结构性行情的乐观预期，以及监管引导下私募业生态的持续优化。（上证报）
text_en: The wave of "rushing to private funds" has continued to surge this year. Information disclosed by the Asset Management Association of China shows that Lingnan Jianshu (Shanghai) Private Fund Management Co., Ltd. ("Lingnan Jianshu Private Fund"), co-founded by Leon Luo (Lorion), former chief quantitative investment officer of Xinyuan Fund, recently completed manager registration, with Lorion serving as legal representative and general manager. According to the reporter's incomplete statistics, nearly 30 investment research professionals who previously worked at public fund and securities firms and other institutions have founded or joined private fund institutions this year. Industry insiders believe that behind more and more people "rushing to private funds" is optimism about structural market opportunities and the continued optimization of the private fund industry ecosystem under regulatory guidance. (Shanghai Securities News)
